description: Applies DSIR, domain mixing, and decontamination to curate pretraining datasets.

outputs.name: curated_manifest
outputs.description: Final ordered list of selected data.

decontamination_ngram_size.description: N-gram size for benchmark decontamination overlap detection.

dsir_num_buckets.description: Number of hash buckets for lightweight DSIR language models.

bloom_filters_loaded.description: Whether benchmark n-grams are loaded into Bloom filters.

metrics.name: tokens_dropped_decontamination

metrics.name: dsir_kl_divergence
metrics.description: KL divergence between source subset and target distribution.
